content.short: BlastScore is a reputation protocol for the Blast ecosystem that quantifies user engagement and on-chain activity.
content.description:
BlastScore is a sophisticated reputation and credentialing protocol designed specifically for the Blast Layer 2 network. It uses a proprietary S.C.O.R.E. algorithm to analyze a user's on-chain activity, including transaction history, dApp interactions, and governance participation. By quantifying these metrics, BlastScore assigns a reputation score that reflects a user's value and contribution to the ecosystem. This score helps projects identify and reward genuine users while filtering out automated "sybil" accounts.

Users can earn BlastScore XP (bXP) by completing various tasks and maintaining high levels of engagement, which can correlate to future rewards and exclusive privileges. The protocol also features a "Proof-of-Yield" system that evaluates a user's contribution to the network's total value locked. By providing a transparent and verifiable way to measure reputation, BlastScore is building a trust layer for the Blast ecosystem, empowering both developers and participants to interact with greater confidence and fair reward distribution.
